## Stage 1: Features and OS 2.0 Compatibility

### Features

#### Faceted search filtering

- Use [search filtering](https://shopify.dev/docs/themes/navigation-search/filtering) so that customers can filter on collection and search pages based on product availability, price, type, vendor, and variant options. You need to support faceted search filtering on collection pages and search pages. Filter values with zero results can still be selected, leading directly to an empty "No products found" page. In accordance with Shopify's storefront filtering guidelines, options returning zero results (e.g., `Digital product (boolean): No (0)`) must be disabled to prevent dead-end states. See [(this screencast)](https://shopify.click/03-24-s0nc1-mlfyl.webm). → SF-FILTER-01

#### Language selection

- When merchants sell [in multiple languages](https://shopify.dev/docs/themes/markets/multiple-currencies-languages#the-language-selector), customers must be able to select their preferred language on the storefront. Selectors must follow the [UX guidelines](https://shopify.dev/docs/themes/markets/country-language-ux). Multiple theme interface strings fail to translate when switching to a non-English locale (e.g., Spanish). In both the cart drawer and cart page, core labels including header titles, column headers, shipping and tax notices (`Tax included. Shipping calculated at checkout.`), and action buttons (`Check out`) remain in English. A full audit across all templates is recommended to ensure all static strings use locale translation keys (`t:` filters). See [(this screencast)](https://shopify.click/03-38-iyyg7-s65gw.webm). → SF-I18N-01

#### Multi-level menus

- Add [nested menus](https://shopify.dev/docs/themes/navigation-search/navigation) so that merchants can create multi-level drop down menus. The second-level mobile navigation menu is not responsive. See [(this screencast)](https://shopify.click/03-02-qhhiy-vy5cv.webm). → SF-MENU-01

#### Newsletter forms

- Add a [newsletter signup](https://shopify.dev/docs/themes/customer-engagement/email-consent#newsletter-sign-up-form) so that merchants can collect customer email addresses to use in email marketing campaigns. An incomplete email address must trigger a validation warning. This functionality is currently missing from Dawn, but it's crucial for input validation. See [(this screencast)](https://shopify.click/03-07-nc52f-6uyya.webm) for additional details → SF-NEWSLETTER-01

## Stage 2: Lighthouse performance and accessibility - Passed

## Stage 3: Technical requirements

### Pages

#### Product page requirements

- The product page must use `cart.taxes_included` to display an indication that taxes are included in the price when a store is using tax-inclusive prices. See [(this screenshot)](https://shopify.click/03-53-3ceo5-krg59.png). → SF-PRODUCT-01

#### Collection page requirements

- Products must be listed in a grid or list, with the following attributes of the [`product` object](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/liquid/objects/product) output: → SF-COLLECTION-01

  - `variant.unit_price`: Missing unit price (`variant.unit_price`) on collection product cards. See [(this screenshot)](https://shopify.click/04-36-c1hqs-65enm.png). On the left side is the Dawn theme for reference.

- The Sale badge or `product.compare_at_price_max` is shown when appropriate: The strikethrough compare-at price (`product.compare_at_price_max`) is not displayed alongside the sale badge on collection product cards. See [(this screenshot)](https://shopify.click/04-47-e2b9o-hw9j5.png). On the left side is the Dawn theme for reference. → SF-COLLECTION-02

#### Blog page requirements

- Attributes of the [`blog` object](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/liquid/objects/blog) must output the [blog.title](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/liquid/objects/blog#blog-title). The blog page template does not output `blog.title` by default. Currently, the native `Title` toggle is disabled by default in favor of a hardcoded `Custom content` block (`"Notes from the shelf."`). It is recommended to enable `blog.title` by default so the actual blog title renders on install. See [(this screencast)](https://shopify.click/04-08-ipff6-thjq6.webm). → SF-BLOG-01

### Consistency and functionality

- All RTE-generated content must be consistent (such as `h1`\-`h6`, `blockquotes`, `ul`, `ol`) across all templates. Styling of RTE content is consistent with those of blog articles, product descriptions, and collection descriptions. → SF-RTE-01
  - Inconsistent typography styles detected across Rich Text Editor (RTE) elements. Heading styles (`h1`–`h6`) fail to render consistently across different sections and templates. See [(screenshot 1)](https://shopify.click/04-38-k68er-nejw4.png) and [(screenshot 2)](https://shopify.click/03-24-adnjk-7nkg3.png) for reference.
- **REMINDER:** The appropriate licenses must be obtained for all third party plugins and images. → SF-LICENSE-01

### Assets

- Themes must not include minified `.css` or `.js` files, with the exception of ES6 and third-party libraries. Shopify automatically minifies CSS files, as well as JavaScript files that use ES5 syntax or lower, when they're requested by the storefront. `xo-webcomponents.min.css` contains minified CSS and does not qualify as an exempt third-party library, so it must be provided unminified. → SF-ASSET-01

### Accessibility

Note: The examples provided below are not a comprehensive list. Please go over your theme entirely and make sure it meets all the requirements.

- All parts of a page must be keyboard accessible, including dropdown navigation. → SF-A11Y-01
  - Interactive elements are skipped during keyboard navigation. When navigating through the page using the `Tab` key, certain focusable elements are bypassed and cannot be reached using the keyboard alone. See [(this screencast)](https://shopify.click/04-25-mrzn1-t4543.webm).
- When navigating with the keyboard, focusable elements must feature a visible focus state. → SF-A11Y-02
  - Missing visible focus indicator during keyboard navigation. When navigating interactive elements with the `Tab` key, focusable links receive focus (as confirmed by the browser preview URL), but fail to display a visible focus state on the storefront. Please ensure all focusable elements feature a visible focus outline. See [(this screencast)](https://shopify.click/04-25-h2bvj-s8vbs.webm).
- All images require the `alt` attribute. Themes must use [`image.alt`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/liquid/objects/image#image-alt) or [`image_url | image_tag: alt: string`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/liquid/filters/image_tag#image_tag-alt) for product images. See [(this screenshot)](https://shopify.click/04-41-givr5-gw833.png). → SF-A11Y-03
- Form inputs must have a unique ID, and labels with `for` attributes that match the input ID. See these [(screenshot 1)](https://shopify.click/04-46-qqx5f-jongf.png), [(screenshot 2)](https://shopify.click/04-48-cu39n-706f2.png), [(screenshot 3)](https://shopify.click/04-51-3h40o-pop5f.png), and [(screenshot 4)](https://shopify.click/04-53-dllwf-vkz1e.png). → SF-A11Y-04
- The size of the touch target for pointer inputs must be at least 24 by 24 CSS pixels. The minimum size doesn't apply to inline body text, or elements that meet other exception criteria. See [(this screenshot)](https://shopify.click/04-05-gsx4v-cl185.png). → SF-A11Y-05
- Headings `h1`\-`h6` must be visually different from each other. → SF-A11Y-06

## Design/UX

### Section Limit

- Multiple header or footer sections cannot be added or activated simultaneously. Both the header and footer section schemas must enforce a strict limit of `1` (`"limit": 1`) to ensure only a single instance of each is active. See [(this screencast)](https://shopify.click/03-19-vcz90-zxp8w.webm). → SF-SECTION-01

### List Alignment

- Unordered and ordered lists (`<ul>` / `<ol>`) render with broken spacing when text alignment is changed. When aligning content to the center or right via theme settings, list markers (bullets and numbers) remain separated by excessive whitespace from their corresponding text rather than maintaining proper inline alignment. Please note that the provided screencasts are just a few examples; a thorough check across all theme sections and templates is strongly advised. See these [(screencast 1)](https://shopify.click/03-33-81d66-2or6r.webm), [(screencast 2)](https://shopify.click/03-48-l90wx-o1kwd.webm), and [(screencast 3)](https://shopify.click/03-06-0oxps-7zo2p.webm). → SF-RTE-02

### Text Inversion

- Adding a hyperlink changes the word order inside the marquee, inverting the phrase from "`Built to last`" to "`to lastBuilt`". See [(this screencast)](https://shopify.click/03-25-fi049-vpocm.webm). → SF-RTE-03

### Text Displacement

- Applying a hyperlink to text inside the card causes the phrase to split and jumps part of the text down to the bottom left. See [(this screencast)](https://shopify.click/03-35-mmv9u-mnzwr.webm). → SF-RTE-03

### Settings & Defaults

- Hardcoded demo resource handle in default settings. The `Caption link` setting within the "Social video" block defaults to `/products/morning-oil`. Resource and URL settings must not default to specific demo handles that do not exist across all merchant stores. See [(this screenshot)](https://shopify.click/03-40-jmsb7-8azvx.png). → SF-SETTINGS-01

### Link Styling

- Missing interactive styling on actionable link. The `"remove all"` control on the empty collection/search state renders as plain body text without an underline, button styling, or visual affordance to indicate it is clickable. See [(this screenshot)](https://shopify.click/04-53-9nn8v-7v8mr.png). → SF-LINK-01

### Stock Logic

- The inventory status component displays "Out of stock" for variants with untracked inventory, even though the product is available for purchase. See [(this screenshot)](https://shopify.click/04-34-uf12a-tnomz.png). → SF-STOCK-01

### Contrast Failure

- The modal close button (`×`) lacks sufficient color contrast against the light background, rendering the dismiss control nearly invisible. See these [(screenshot 1)](https://shopify.click/04-39-t2uwv-f360p.png) and [(screenshot 2)](https://shopify.click/04-41-8l3vk-4f55o.png). → SF-CONTRAST-01

### Variant Availability

- Swatches display strikethroughs and disabled hover states for valid combinations; for example, when `Cat` is selected with `M/L`, the `Dog` swatch shows a strikethrough even though the `Dog` option is available in size `S/M`. See [(this screencast)](https://shopify.click/04-49-qnhml-s8dle.webm). → SF-VARIANT-01
